NVDA.fair_value_reasoning: Starting point: research target (12m) $263.97 (supervisor.json, engine: P/E leg weight 0.6 at 16.73x exit, FCF-yield leg weight 0.4). (1) Key-person tail: if the probe ends with Huang leaving or sharply cut back within the 12 months, I assume the target falls about 20% (loss of the founder's role in customer, supply and Washington relationships, plus a lower exit multiple). Probability I give that outcome: about 12% (board publicly backs him, says no sign of compromise, Huang is cooperating; but outcome unknown and Congress already asked for a briefing). 0.12 x -20% = -2.4%.
